name: find_matches
description: Finds as many relevant matches as possible from data columns with queried keywords derived from the prompt. Call this function when you need to access specific event, company, or user data. For example, 'I want to know if IBM is available for a meeting at 2pm.'

col.description: The columns in the data relevant to the prompt.

items.description: A keyword to query for in the associated colunn.

keywords.description: All the possible keywords to query that can be derived from the prompt. Generate at least 3 relevant keywords

items.description: A query object for the relevant column and its associated keywords.

parameters.description: An object for the parameters of the function.
